milestones.label: Applications open for the 2027/28 cycle
milestones.source_text: Chevening's application timeline (official) says applications open in August 2026; several news sites report 4 August 2026.

milestones.label: Application deadline (2027/28 cycle; exact day and time are on each country page, 11:00 UTC)
milestones.source_text: Chevening's timeline (official) gives October 2026 with a 11:00 UTC cut-off and sends applicants to their country page for the exact day; several outlets report 6 October 2026.

milestones.label: Embassies shortlist candidates and invite them to interview
milestones.source_text: Chevening (official) says British embassies and high commissions shortlist and invite candidates to interview from mid-February 2027.

milestones.label: Interviews at British embassies and high commissions
milestones.source_text: Chevening (official) places interviews in March and April 2027.

milestones.label: Interview results announced
milestones.source_text: Chevening (official) says results start to be announced from mid-June 2027.

milestones.label: Deadline for a first unconditional UK university offer
milestones.source_text: Chevening (official) says successful candidates need at least one unconditional UK university offer by 17:00 BST on 8 July 2027.
